# House rules for my tools

- Put each new tool in its own folder, like tool-name/index.html, so it gets its own web link. Leave the tip calculator where it is.
- Each tool is one standalone page: plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no build step, no outside libraries.
- Design for a phone first, then make sure it also works on a computer.
- Keep it simple, clear, accessible and fast.
- Never add tracking, sign-ins, or anything that sends data anywhere.
